notes.title: Turkish
notes.content: Now the game supports Turkish language! Many thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/seljuktheking/]Seljuk[/url] for his great work. Also we fixed fonts on lower screen resolutions.

notes.title: Christmas Event
notes.content:
This month, we have prepared a special event for you. It's still Match3, but in a completely different style. You’ll need not only wits but also quick reflexes. Just like in classic Chronobabes, you’ll have 4 skills here. Charge them up and try to survive as long as possible.

Want a full-fledged game in this genre? If so, let us know in the comments and leave a positive review – it will give us extra motivation.

Merry Christmas, Chronomen! May time be with you!

notes.title: Make America Hot Again
notes.content:
Fight for the future of the USA. Play as Donald Drump and defeat Kamala Karris in a fair battle for voters' support. A special event is available from the main menu.

Note: All characters are fictional, and any resemblances are purely coincidental.

notes.title: Halloween event
notes.content: Halloween is just around the corner! Discover the first special event in Chronobabes — accessible right from the main menu. Ki'Li and Ras'Kan are busy with festive pumpkin preparations, and they need your help! Look forward to a new battle featuring a unique Halloween gem on the board and the chance to earn a special achievement.

notes.title: Version 1.8.0 Prehistoric fun
notes.content:
Let's be honest, the first act is a little boring compared to others, it lacks skills and damage. And Ai'Nu generally steals skulls on the board, which slows the game down even more. So we want to fix this!

Now Alex starts the game with the artifact "Family Watch", which can shuffle all the gems on the board once per battle. Use it when there are no good moves and you urgently need to change something.

Ai'Nu (the boss of the first act) has been completely changed. Now at the beginning of her turn, she charges two random skulls on the board by +1. And her skill "Ritual" deals damage equal to the entire power of all the skulls on the Board! Be careful, do not leave skulls, otherwise you will receive such damage that it will be hard to recover!

notes.title: Version 1.7 Inspector34
notes.content:
Thanks to the feedback from players of the demo version and curators who played the full version of the game, we've gathered a lot of useful insights, inspected them, and made adjustments. Now, the gameplay will be more fun and engaging!

Changes:

Added a current turn number indicator, as some artifacts depend on the turn number.
The turn indicator is now more informative. It glows green when it’s the player’s turn and red when it's the AI's turn.
Added undressing indicators.
Skill cards now display a pattern if the skill affects a specific zone.
There is now a 2% chance for a +4 power gem to appear on the board.
There’s a chance for powerful skulls to appear on the board with up to +5 power.
The balance has been adjusted, reducing the HP of both the player and opponents.
The Jasmi Scroll now clearly shows the number of lines in the fairy tale.
Multiple minor text and dialogue improvements.
Minor bugs fixed, and performance improved.

notes.title: 1.6 Firefly
notes.content:
[h2]4 new skills[/h2]

1) Embers (red) – Ignites 4 random gems.
2) Carbon Monoxide (green) – deals 1 damage for each burning gem.
3) Earthquake (yellow) – on the bottom row, all gems with 2+ power are set on fire, the rest are destroyed.
4) Storm (green) – on the top row, all gems with 2+ power are set on fire, the rest are destroyed.

[h2]Mosquito in Amber Artifact[/h2]
When you use a skill, buffs two random skulls on the board

[i]Can be found in Act 1[/i]

[h2]Rebalance[/h2]
Some battles have been sped up for more fun

notes.title: Japanese support
notes.content: We have added support for the Japanese language. This affects all game texts. In addition, some translations for other languages have been corrected. The voices of the girls are still only in English, but I think we will work on that too!

notes.title: Gameplay Acceleration
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Enhanced gems now appear more frequently, especially +2. All skills will charge slightly faster.
[*] Hero's HP has been slightly reduced.
[*] The HP of first epoch enemies (Ki'Li, Ras'Kan, and Ai'Nu) has been reduced.
[*] Some enemies have been strengthened and play better.
[*] A new artifact "Green Powder" has been added.
[/list]
